definition-dropped.answer: Here the TYPE clause is format 1, a reference to a type declaration, so the term applies. §2002:4 type (for type declaration) 'A template that contains all the characteristics of a data item and its subordinates' is word for word §2023:8.5.3.1's first sentence; the meaning of 'a TYPE clause that references the record' is the same, so the scope is unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:8.5.3 ('A type is referenced in a data description entry by specifying the TYPE clause') is what SR4 rests on, and it is the 2023 text; 2023 adds only equivalence details (EXTERNAL/STRONG presence, bit positions) that do not bear on a TYPE naming its enclosing record. §2002:8.5.4 and §2002:14.5.8 are not involved. The witness l1c27-same-as-type-of-enclosing-record is refused (COBOL1557) at --std 2002, so evidence stands.
